def scan_failed(self, error):
        self.search_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.live_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.stop_button.setVisible(False)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self.status.setText("Live refresh failed - cached results preserved")
        self.header_status.setText("LIVE REFRESH FAILED / CACHE PRESERVED")
        if not self._closing:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Could not refresh",
                "GolfHub kept the previous cached results.\n\n" + error.splitlines()[-1],
            )

54e9f02545ee7b7200ea2c506a6e7da77059654c.source:
def scan_failed(self, error):
        self.search_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.live_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.stop_button.setVisible(False)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        if self.last_results:
            self.status.setText("Live refresh failed - previous results kept")
            self.header_status.setText("LIVE REFRESH FAILED / PREVIOUS RESULTS KEPT")
            message = "GolfHub kept the previous results on screen."
        else:
            self.status.setText("Live refresh failed - no results available")
            self.header_status.setText("LIVE REFRESH FAILED")
            message = "Could not load tee-time results. Try Find Tee Times or Refresh Live again."
        if not self._closing:
            if not self.last_results:
                self.render_empty(message)
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Could not refresh",
                message + "\n\n" + error.splitlines()[-1],
            )

1ff79e0916aed28e4fc0168a55044ff8c62364eb.source:
def scan_thread_done(self):
        thread = self.scan_thread
        if thread is None:
            return
        if not thread.wait(0):
            self._scan_cleanup_timer.start(10)
            return
        self._scan_cleanup_timer.stop()
        thread.deleteLater()
        self.scan_thread = None
        self.scan_worker = None
        self._finish_pending_close()

8ae68560185288346e035952dc03487e08ce25ed.source:
def search_live(self, context=None):
        p = context if isinstance(context, dict) else self.params()
        if not p or (self.scan_thread and self._thread_running(self.scan_thread)):
            return
        p = self._snapshot_search_context(p)
        if len(p.get("dates") or [p["date"]]) != 1:
            self.status.setText("Live refresh is available for one date; multi-day results use the 10-minute cache")
            return
        self.context = p
        if not self.last_results:
            self.render_empty("Checking courses live...")
        self.status.setText("Checking courses live...")
        self.header_status.setText("LIVE REFRESH IN PROGRESS")
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
